name: Seed of the West
portraitDescription: Cat-like humanoids with fur patterns matching various felines (leopard, tiger, etc.). Agile and curious. Wearing stained robes with many glass vials and pouches, smelling faintly of sulfur, looking eccentric. The character is exceptionally attractive and a pleasure to look at, with elegant features. Key features: feline head, fur patterns, claws, long tail.
